scope: Read-only source audit for run66 slow progression while CPU logging reportedly off; no runtime/QMP/VM actions or host-pressure diagnosis
finding: No source path found whereby startup dfilter alone modifies TB translation, chaining, instruction limits or CPU logging mask. This does not establish actual runtime mask or explain observed slowdown.

source_points.fact: Option invokes qemu_set_dfilter_ranges: parse ranges and store debug_regions only. No log-mask or TCG cflag changes.
CF_NO_GOTO_TB added for explicit CPU_LOG_TB_NOCHAIN (or separately existing singlestep/oneinsn settings), not debug_regions.
CPU/exec logs call range predicate only after enabledCPU/EXEC check. Stop-chain message gatedEXEC.
Range checks only under IN_ASM/OUT_ASM/EXEC masks; no generated-code change from range membership.
OP dump range checks under OP/OP_IND/OP_OPT log masks. Optimization passes execute independently of filter.
qemu_log_mask_and_addr short-circuits mask before addressfilter. No uses found in target/arm, Apple SoC board or ADPv4 source.
CONFIG_TRACE_LOG adds LOG_TRACE to selected mask; it does not imply CPU/EXEC/NOCHAIN bits.

limitations: A filter can affect output of enabled address-filtered logging categories; conclusion is specific to baselineguest_errors/LOG_TRACE and reviewedARMpath.
